purpose: Locate the local planskip USE_REMOTE_FETCH regression; no builds or timings are authorized by this file.

timing.schedule: For block b, rotate cells left b. For cell position c, rotate chronological arms left (2*b+2*c) mod 9; reverse arm order when (b+c) is odd. No resuming, rerunning, or adaptive sampling.
timing.gate: Hold fast.lock; no active Bazel clients/actions or testcontainers before and after 60 seconds settle; load1 <=7.5 after settle; one storage server and initially empty owned range. Abort on renewed build/testcontainer activity, any process/audit failure, changed binary/plan, or deadline. Do not extend slot.
timing.runtime_estimate: 144 processes at ~6 seconds is 14m24s, plus settle and cleanup; projection only, hard stop at 20 minutes.

estimators.process: Median ns/op of exactly three successful testing.B result lines matching the one scheduled benchmark. Require at least three paired before/after audit receipts (calibration adds pairs) and one fixture receipt, all exact expected path/rows/checksum; no profiling.
estimators.primary: For each direction and arm, geometric mean over four complete blocks of median_ns(arm, USE_REMOTE_FETCH) / median_ns(old, USE_REMOTE_FETCH).
secondary: Adjacent chronological arm ratios for each direction/method, geometric mean over the same four blocks.
Each arm's USE_REMOTE_FETCH / SCAN_AND_FETCH ratio within each block/direction, geometric mean over four blocks.
Difference-in-differences: (remote_arm/remote_old)/(ordinary_arm/ordinary_old) within block/direction, geometric mean over four blocks.
estimators.dispersion: Report the four individual block ratios and their min/max; these ranges are not confidence intervals. Preserve all three raw repeats, ns/op medians, allocation metrics, process position, wall time and load snapshots.
estimators.completeness: Publish comparative estimators only if all 144 processes complete successfully, each arm/cell has four blocks, and gate/provenance/audits remain valid. A partial/failed run is diagnostic only; no outlier or slow-process deletion.
